# Town of Ryegate municipal roster backfill -- Vermont

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Ryegate, 2016 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' table (the report posted on the town's website): Ryegate elects a moderator at its annual meeting; no official source publishes the current holder
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Ryegate, Town Clerk page (ryegatevt.org): Elizabeth Page is the Town Clerk (Marsha Nelson is Assistant Town Clerk)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Elizabeth Page as Ryegate's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Elizabeth Page as Ryegate's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Ryegate, Treasurer page (ryegatevt.org): Lorinda Blood is the Town Treasurer (Pat Crocker is Assistant Treasurer)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Lorinda Blood as Ryegate's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Cheryl Slayton as Ryegate's Town Treasurer -- superseded by the town's own current page and the June 2026 treasurer spreadsheet; Slayton, who held the office in 2016, is not recorded as the current holder

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Ryegate's three selectboard members: Regina Hazel, Darryl Perkins, and Andrew Smith

Town of Ryegate, Board of Selectmen page (ryegatevt.org): the selectboard members are Regina Hazel, Darryl Perkins, and Andrew Smith. This Andrew Smith is a Ryegate resident and a different man from the Town of Berkshire's selectboard member of the same name
